import pandas as pd
import numpy as np


def get_features(db: dict, entity_ids, seed_time) -> pd.DataFrame:
    orders = db["orders"]
    order_items = db["order_items"].copy()
    reviews = db["reviews"]
    payments = db["payments"]

    # ----------------------
    # Orders: keep only what is known at seed_time.
    # Status of a "delivered" order is only known once delivery happened;
    # carrier date only once handed to carrier.
    # ----------------------
    orders_k = orders.copy()
    known_delivery = orders_k["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna() & (orders_k["order_delivered_customer_date"] < seed_time)
    known_carrier = orders_k["order_delivered_carrier_date"].notna() & (orders_k["order_delivered_carrier_date"] < seed_time)
    # A status other than a pre-delivery status is only reliable after the corresponding event
    orders_k["status_known_delivered"] = known_delivery
    # Mask dates that are in the future relative to seed_time (shouldn't exist but be safe)
    for col in ["order_approved_at", "order_delivered_carrier_date", "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date"]:
        orders_k.loc[orders_k[col] >= seed_time, col] = pd.NaT
    # Status: if delivery not yet known, treat anything after "shipped" as not yet determinable
    orders_k.loc[~known_carrier & orders_k["order_status"].isin(["shipped", "delivered"]), "order_status"] = "shipped"
    orders_k.loc[~known_delivery & (orders_k["order_status"] == "delivered"), "order_status"] = "shipped"

    # ----------------------
    # Payments: only payments recorded before seed_time.
    # payments.ts is the purchase time of the order; a payment for an order
    # bought before seed_time but approved later is not fully knowable.
    # Use ts < seed_time as the availability criterion.
    # ----------------------
    payments_k = payments[payments["ts"] < seed_time].copy()

    payments_agg = payments_k.groupby("order_id").agg(
        total_order_payment=("payment_value", "sum"),
        avg_payment_installments=("payment_installments", "mean"),
        num_payment_sequentials=("payment_sequential", "count")
    ).reset_index()

    payment_type_dummies = pd.get_dummies(payments_k[["order_id", "payment_type"]], columns=["payment_type"])
    payment_type_dummies = payment_type_dummies.groupby("order_id").sum().reset_index()
    payments_agg = payments_agg.merge(payment_type_dummies, on="order_id", how="left")
    payment_type_cols = [c for c in payment_type_dummies.columns if c.startswith("payment_type_")]
    for col in payment_type_cols:
        payments_agg[f"{col}_pct"] = payments_agg[col] / payments_agg["num_payment_sequentials"]
    payments_agg = payments_agg.drop(columns=payment_type_cols + ["num_payment_sequentials"])
    # Fill pct columns for orders with no payment rows later; here ensure columns exist
    for base_t in ["credit_card", "boleto", "voucher", "debit_card"]:
        col = f"payment_type_{base_t}_pct"
        if col not in payments_agg.columns:
            payments_agg[col] = 0.0

    # ----------------------
    # Reviews: a review is only visible once it was created (< seed_time)
    # ----------------------
    reviews_k = reviews[reviews["review_creation_date"] < seed_time].copy()
    reviews_k = reviews_k.merge(
        orders_k[["order_id", "order_purchase_timestamp"]],
        on="order_id", how="left"
    )
    reviews_k["days_to_review_creation"] = (
        reviews_k["review_creation_date"] - reviews_k["order_purchase_timestamp"]
    ).dt.total_seconds() / (24 * 3600)

    reviews_agg = reviews_k.groupby("order_id").agg(
        avg_order_review_score=("review_score", "mean"),
        total_reviews_per_order=("review_id", "count"),
        pct_reviews_with_title=("review_comment_title", lambda x: x.notna().mean()),
        pct_reviews_with_message=("review_comment_message", lambda x: x.notna().mean()),
        avg_days_to_review=("days_to_review_creation", "mean")
    ).reset_index()

    # ----------------------
    # Base: order items with purchase time (ts) strictly before seed_time
    # ----------------------
    order_items = order_items[order_items["ts"] < seed_time].copy()

    order_items_orders = order_items.merge(
        orders_k[["order_id", "customer_id", "order_status",
                  "order_purchase_timestamp", "order_delivered_carrier_date",
                  "order_delivered_customer_date", "order_estimated_delivery_date",
                  "status_known_delivered"]],
        on="order_id", how="inner"
    )

    order_items_full = order_items_orders.merge(payments_agg, on="order_id", how="left")
    order_items_full = order_items_full.merge(reviews_agg, on="order_id", how="left")

    # Delivery timing features: only meaningful if delivery already happened before seed_time
    delivered_mask = order_items_full["status_known_delivered"].fillna(False)

    order_items_full["days_to_carrier"] = np.where(
        delivered_mask & order_items_full["order_delivered_carrier_date"].notna(),
        (order_items_full["order_delivered_carrier_date"] - order_items_full["order_purchase_timestamp"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0,
        np.nan
    )
    order_items_full["days_carrier_to_customer"] = np.where(
        delivered_mask & order_items_full["order_delivered_carrier_date"].notna() & order_items_full["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna(),
        (order_items_full["order_delivered_customer_date"] - order_items_full["order_delivered_carrier_date"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0,
        np.nan
    )
    order_items_full["delivery_delay_days"] = np.where(
        delivered_mask & order_items_full["order_delivered_customer_date"].notna(),
        (order_items_full["order_delivered_customer_date"] - order_items_full["order_estimated_delivery_date"]).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0,
        np.nan
    )

    order_items_full["is_canceled"] = (order_items_full["order_status"] == "canceled").astype(int)
    order_items_full["is_delivered"] = (order_items_full["order_status"] == "delivered").astype(int)
    order_items_full["is_late"] = np.where(
        delivered_mask,
        (order_items_full["delivery_delay_days"] > 0).astype(float),
        np.nan
    )

    # Lookback windows based on purchase time (ts)
    # ----------------------
    lookback_windows = [
        ("7d", pd.Timedelta(days=7)),
        ("14d", pd.Timedelta(days=14)),
        ("30d", pd.Timedelta(days=30)),
        ("90d", pd.Timedelta(days=90)),
        ("180d", pd.Timedelta(days=180)),
        ("all", None)
    ]
    window_names = [w[0] for w in lookback_windows]

    base_features = pd.DataFrame(index=pd.Index(entity_ids, name="product_id"))

    order_level_cols = ["is_canceled", "is_delivered", "is_late",
                        "days_to_carrier", "days_carrier_to_customer", "delivery_delay_days",
                        "total_order_payment", "avg_payment_installments",
                        "payment_type_credit_card_pct", "payment_type_boleto_pct",
                        "payment_type_voucher_pct", "payment_type_debit_card_pct",
                        "avg_order_review_score", "total_reviews_per_order",
                        "pct_reviews_with_title", "pct_reviews_with_message", "avg_days_to_review"]

    for window_name, window_delta in lookback_windows:
        if window_delta is not None:
            start_time = seed_time - window_delta
            window_data = order_items_full[
                (order_items_full["ts"] >= start_time) & (order_items_full["ts"] < seed_time)
            ].copy()
        else:

            unique_orders=("order_id", "nunique"),
            unique_sellers=("seller_id", "nunique"),
            unique_customers=("customer_id", "nunique"),
            total_revenue=("price", "sum"),
            total_freight=("freight_value", "sum"),
            avg_unit_price=("price", "mean"),
            avg_unit_freight=("freight_value", "mean"),
            last_sale_time=("ts", "max"),
            first_sale_time=("ts", "min")
        ).reset_index()

        line_item_feats["days_since_last_sale"] = (
            seed_time - line_item_feats["last_sale_time"]
        ).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        line_item_feats["product_age_days"] = (
            seed_time - line_item_feats["first_sale_time"]
        ).dt.total_seconds() / 86400.0
        line_item_feats = line_item_feats.drop(columns=["last_sale_time", "first_sale_time"])

        existing_cols = [c for c in order_level_cols if c in window_data.columns]

            pct_delivered_orders=("is_delivered", "mean"),
            pct_late_deliveries=("is_late", "mean"),
            avg_days_to_carrier=("days_to_carrier", "mean"),
            avg_days_carrier_to_customer=("days_carrier_to_customer", "mean"),
            avg_delivery_delay=("delivery_delay_days", "mean"),

            avg_days_to_review=("avg_days_to_review", "mean")
        ).reset_index()

        window_features = line_item_feats.merge(order_level_feats, on="product_id", how="outer")
        rename_map = {col: f"{col}_{window_name}" for col in window_features.columns if col != "product_id"}
        window_features = window_features.rename(columns=rename_map).set_index("product_id")

        base_features[f"has_sales_{win}"] = (base_features[sales_col] > 0).astype(int) if sales_col in base_features.columns else 0

    count_sum_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if any(k in c for k in count_sum_keys)]
    base_features[count_sum_cols] = base_features[count_sum_cols].fillna(0)

    days_since_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if "days_since_last_sale" in c]
    base_features[days_since_cols] = base_features[days_since_cols].fillna(1e5)

    age_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns if "product_age_days" in c]
    base_features[age_cols] = base_features[age_cols].fillna(0)

    remaining_cols = [c for c in base_features.columns
                      if c not in count_sum_cols + days_since_cols + age_cols + indicator_cols]
    base_features[remaining_cols] = base_features[remaining_cols].fillna(0)

    base_features = base_features.reindex(entity_ids)
    base_features.index.name = "product_id"
